issues: The sentence was only ~99px effective and the short ACME mark filled 1/7 of the width, floating in empty black with no weight
Cold white glow on a near-monochrome grey stage made the grain read as foggy blur with no energy
Sentence and short mark used the same typeface, just bigger and bolder, so 'a sentence boiled down to a name' did not come across
60f was too short: almost no hold after the lock, the mark ended as soon as it was legible
changes: Ember look (warm black, orange, gold): the grain is heat, with a two-layer warm bloom; the condensed mark is a white-hot-to-orange vertical gradient with a lingering warm glow
Typographic contrast: the line is monospace code '{ Kova 3 — now live }' and condenses into a 300px heavy sans wordmark KOVA (42% of frame width); code becoming brand is the story
The filter now runs at native 1920 coordinates with high-frequency noise, big displacement and only 0.55px blur, so the grains are real 2–3px sand instead of fog

180 embers blow out and drift upward on the heat, then accelerate back in with ease-in, stretched into streaks by speed; the amber hatched selection box with a mono tag springs open and squeezes shut sideways, foreshadowing the compression
60→84f: 10f clean state, grain and boil, condense with one light streak, the subline 'Now live, everywhere.' rises word by word, then an 18f hold, with a 3.5% slow push throughout
